unit_of_analysis: 14 analysis units from the 15 PMC administrative wards (2017 boundaries, OpenCity KML); Kondhwa-Wanavdi is merged into Bibwewadi because the 2011 census office "Bibvewadi" contains the Kondhva wards

measured_or_official.Population, Households, Children_Pct, SC: Census of India 2011, PMC ward-wise tables (OpenCity)
measured_or_official.Area_sqkm, Center_Latitude/Longitude: computed from the PMC administrative ward polygons
measured_or_official.PM2_5, PM10, NO2: IITM / MPCB station readings 2024-25 (OpenCity), daily means with QC, interpolated to ward centroids by inverse-distance weighting (power 2)
measured_or_official.AQI: CPCB sub-index method on daily PM2.5, PM10 and NO2 (max sub-index), averaged over days
measured_or_official.Schools, Hospitals, Banks, Shopping_Mall: OpenStreetMap point counts inside each ward (Overpass API)
measured_or_official.Road_Length_km, Road_Network_Density: OpenStreetMap highway lengths clipped to each ward

proxies_not_measurements.Congestion_Index: NOT measured congestion. Population per km of OSM road, min-max scaled to 0-100 across the analysis units.
proxies_not_measurements.Green_Cover_Percentage: Share of ward area covered by OSM parks, gardens, forest, grass, scrub and meadow polygons. Depends on OSM completeness; not satellite NDVI.
proxies_not_measurements.Open_Spaces_sqkm: Same OSM green polygons, in km2.

limitations: Only 7 air-quality stations; most wards receive interpolated, not measured, values.
Station coordinates come from geocoding the station's locality name and are approximate.
Census is 2011 while air quality is 2024-25 and boundaries are 2017; population density therefore mixes years.
Aundh and Bibwewadi-Kondhwa include areas merged into PMC after 2011, so their 2011-based density is understated.
Fourteen units is a small sample for clustering.
2011 census ward offices and 2017 administrative wards share names but not exact boundaries; apart from the Bibwewadi/Kondhwa merge, densities are approximate.
